question: Should CodexBar adopt ZenMux as a first-class built-in provider and own its Management API, branding, documentation, and provider-specific presentation over time?
rationale: The implementation is technically credible and proven, but source review cannot decide whether this third-party provider belongs in the maintained built-in provider set.

options.title: Accept ZenMux provider
options.body: Proceed with ordinary maintainer review and merge once required checks are satisfactory, keeping the provider disabled by default.

options.title: Narrow the integration
options.body: Ask the contributor to reduce provider-specific presentation or generated-site churn before reconsidering the built-in provider.

options.title: Decline built-in support
options.body: Close the PR if CodexBar does not want to own ZenMux API and branding compatibility as part of core.

recommendation.title: Accept ZenMux provider
recommendation.body: Proceed with ordinary maintainer review and merge once required checks are satisfactory, keeping the provider disabled by default.

likelyOwner.reason: As repository owner and the clearest owner of provider architecture and release scope, steipete is the best available person to decide whether the built-in provider set should expand.
